html:
Conectividade para seus dispositivos

Recursos para conectar a TV à rede e a dispositivos externos.

  • HDMI 2.1 com ARC

    São 4 entradas HDMI 2.1, sendo 1 com ARC, indicadas para consoles e soundbars.

  • Wi-Fi Dual Band

    Conexão mais estável nas frequências de 2,4 GHz e 5 GHz.

  • 2 USB 2.0 para conectar

    Duas entradas USB 2.0 para conexão de dispositivos externos.

  • Controle por aplicativo e voz

    Use o Roku App ou comandos de voz com Alexa e Google Assistente.
name: Section-37
css:
<style>
        .section-37 {
            --s37-color-surface: #060708;
            --s37-color-card: #101214;
            --s37-color-border: #262b30;
            --s37-color-text: #f3f5f6;
            --s37-color-muted: #d2d5d8;
            --s37-color-brand: #f4bc58;
            --s37-color-accent: #a765ff;
            background-color: var(--s37-color-surface);
            border-radius: 0 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;
            color: var(--s37-color-text);
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: 2.5rem 1rem;
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .section-37__container {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .section-37__content {
            align-items: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .section-37__title,
        .section-37__card-title {
            font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
            margin: 0;
            overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        }

        .section-37__title {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4.8vw, 2rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
        }

        .section-37__intro,
        .section-37__card-text {
            font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
            margin: 0;
            overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        }

        .section-37__intro {
            color: var(--s37-color-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 3vw, 1rem);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .section-37__viewport {
            overflow: hidden;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .section-37__track {
            align-items: stretch;
            display: flex;
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
        }

        .section-37__item {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            flex: 0 0 100%;
            min-width: 0;
            padding: 0.5rem;
        }

        .section-37__card {
            align-items: center;
            background-color: var(--s37-color-card);
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            border-radius: 1rem;
            box-shadow: 0 1rem 2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1rem;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            text-align: center;
            transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .section-37__figure {
            aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            width: 90px;
        }

        .section-37__image {
            display: block;
            height: auto;
            object-fit: contain;
            width: 100%;
            transition: transform 0.45s ease;
        }

        .section-37__card-title {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.125rem);
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .section-37__highlight {
            color: var(--s37-color-brand);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .section-37__item:nth-child(2) .section-37__highlight,
        .section-37__item:nth-child(4) .section-37__highlight {
            color: var(--s37-color-accent);
        }

        .section-37__card-text {
            color: var(--s37-color-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2.8vw, 0.9375rem);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .section-37__controls {
            align-items: center;
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        .section-37__control {
            height: 1px;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            position: absolute;
            width: 1px;
        }

        .section-37__button {
            align-items: center;
            background-color: var(--s37-color-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--s37-color-border);
            border-radius: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--s37-color-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 0.875rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            height: 2.5rem;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: background-color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
            width: 2.5rem;
        }

        .section-37__button-number {
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .section-37__control:checked+.section-37__button {
            background-color: var(--s37-color-brand);
            border-color: var(--s37-color-brand);
            color: var(--s37-color-surface);
        }

        .section-37__control:focus-visible+.section-37__button {
            outline: 2px solid var(--s37-color-accent);
            outline-offset: 2px;
        }

        .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-1:checked) .section-37__track {
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-2:checked) .section-37__track {
            transform: translateX(-100%);
        }

        .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-3:checked) .section-37__track {
            transform: translateX(-200%);
        }

        .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-4:checked) .section-37__track {
            transform: translateX(-300%);
        }

        @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
            .section-37__card:hover {
                border-color: var(--s37-color-brand);
                box-shadow: 0 1rem 2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
                transform: translateY(-4px);
            }

            .section-37__card:hover .section-37__image {
                transform: scale(1.05);
            }

            .section-37__button:hover {
                border-color: var(--s37-color-brand);
                color: var(--s37-color-text);
                transform: translateY(-2px);
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 576px) {
            .section-37 {
                padding: 3rem 1.5rem;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .section-37 {
                padding: 3rem 2rem;
            }

            .section-37__content {
                margin-bottom: 2rem;
            }

            .section-37__item {
                flex-basis: 50%;
            }

            .section-37__button--mobile-only {
                border-width: 0;
                height: 0;
                opacity: 0;
                overflow: hidden;
                pointer-events: none;
                position: absolute;
                width: 0;
            }

            .section-37__card-text {
                text-align: left;
                width: 100%;
            }

            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-1:checked) .section-37__track {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }

            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-2:checked) .section-37__track {
                transform: translateX(-100%);
            }

            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-3:checked) .section-37__track,
            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-4:checked) .section-37__track {
                transform: translateX(-100%);
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 992px) {
            .section-37__container {
                width: calc(100% - 4rem);
            }

            .section-37__card-title {
                min-height: 3rem;
                width: 100%;
            }

            .section-37__item {
                flex-basis: calc(100% / 3);
            }

            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-2:checked) .section-37__track,
            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-3:checked) .section-37__track,
            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-4:checked) .section-37__track {
                transform: translateX(calc(-100% / 3));
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 1200px) {
            .section-37 {
                padding: 3rem;
            }

            .section-37__container {
                width: calc(100% - 6rem);
            }

            .section-37__viewport {
                overflow: visible;
            }

            .section-37__track {
                transform: none;
            }

            .section-37__item {
                flex-basis: 25%;
            }

            .section-37__controls {
                height: 0;
                margin-top: 0;
                opacity: 0;
                overflow: hidden;
                pointer-events: none;
            }

            .section-37__controls:focus-within {
                height: 2.5rem;
                margin-top: 1rem;
                opacity: 1;
                overflow: visible;
                pointer-events: auto;
            }

            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-1:checked) .section-37__track,
            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-2:checked) .section-37__track,
            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-3:checked) .section-37__track,
            .section-37:has(#section-37-slide-4:checked) .section-37__track {
                transform: none;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 1400px) {
            .section-37__container {
                width: calc(100% - 8rem);
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

            .section-37__track,
            .section-37__card,
            .section-37__image,
            .section-37__button {
                transition: none;
            }
        }
    </style>
